runs.failure_point: Asserted extra matters as qualifying on the strength of keyword snippets alone.

first_error.why: Wrote the answer straight from scan snippets without opening any document and listed a non-qualifying matter as a concrete example.

other_errors.why: A later edit added another non-qualifying matter as a secondary precedent.

divergence: All three runs surfaced every needed matter (extraction scans and a file-name search). The passing runs (T0, T1) opened documents from each candidate before writing and listed borderline matters as excluded; T2 wrote straight from a 555K-char scan dump without opening a single document, asserted an extra matter, then added another in an edit (fails precision only).
